description: UNDERSTANDING — the workspace root: which plan you are on, how many saved searches and lists you hold, and where each lives. Answers "what do I have here and what can I afford" in one call, so an agent need not probe. NOT the same as the account (login, API key, usage, billing), which is https://apis.io/api/v1/auth/me. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: my_workspace
